faq.q: Should I repair my fridge or replace it?
faq.a: It depends on the fault and the age of the fridge. We look at it first, then tell you what we found and what each option would cost.

faq.q: My fridge works on electric but not on propane. Can you fix that?
faq.a: Yes. We check both the electric and the propane side and find where the fault is.

faq.q: How much does an appliance repair cost?
faq.a: It depends on the appliance and the fault, so we quote after we’ve inspected it.
